callback_message: If everything is wired up, you should see live counts for active Branches, open Findings, royalty totals and inspection coverage. The numbers populate as soon as you have one Branch + one Inspection Visit recorded.
description:
## See the whole franchise in one view

`MYS Central Monitoring` aggregates the eight headline metrics Head Office watches — active Branches, open Findings, royalty receivable, attendance gaps, and more — into a single dashboard the CEO and Finance Dept Heads land on every morning.

The charts and number cards auto-scope to whatever Branches the logged-in user can see, so the same dashboard is safe to grant to a Cluster Director (sees only her cluster) or a Branch Director (sees only his branch).
name: MYS View Central Dashboard
title: View the Central Monitoring Dashboard
